items.title: Were the reviewed ecosystem Burmese text issues corrected?
assumptions: Only the 13 ecosystem records and 15 fields identified in the preceding audit were in scope.
The broad non-standard ဥ်/ဉ် group was not part of this correction request unless it occurred inside one of the explicitly identified typo strings.

source.label: Wildlife ecosystem data
caveats: The Kachin-Sagaing low-elevation rainforest record exists in the JSON source but is absent from the database catalog, so its correction applies only to the source file.
Protected-area data was outside this correction request and was not changed.

evidenceFlow.title: Targeted pattern validation
evidenceFlow.detail: All reviewed incorrect spellings and repeated phrases were absent from the 15 corrected source fields after the update.

evidenceFlow.title: Database parity and integrity
evidenceFlow.detail: All 14 reviewed fields belonging to the 12 database-backed records matched the corrected JSON source, and SQLite integrity_check returned ok.

sourceRoles.label: data/ecosystems.json
sourceRoles.role: Canonical ecosystem records containing the 15 corrected Burmese fields.

sourceRoles.label: wildlife.db
sourceRoles.role: Application database synchronized for the 12 reviewed ecosystem records currently present in the catalog.
